campaign.zc1.description:
Fire and Smoke, peal of swords and whistle of arrows...
Many years have passed since those glorious battles.
Life is more or less peaceful now. All clans and groups licked their wounds.
But what is a life without fighting!?
campaign.zc1.name: In the Wake of Gods
campaign.zc2.description:
He is called the Samaritan. 
Nobody knows his real power. 
Please play and discover his history.

by Bruno
campaign.zc2.name: The Samaritan
campaign.zc3.description:
Your name is Nailag Ciad.
You have always dreamed of becoming an adventurer,
and now that you have reached adulthood,
your dream seems to be coming true. 
But how does one start being an adventurer?
campaign.zc3.name: A Life of A-d-v-e-n-t-u-r-e
campaign.zc4.description: Xsi had the order to spy the humans for the Necromancer. But she wasn´t lucky. The humans realised her plans, hunted and prisonded her in a small valley. Now it`s on you to bring Xsi back home to the Necromancer. All maps are planed to play "expert". If you want choose your difficulty!
campaign.zc4.name: Evil Way Home

map.cave of gerfrex.event.13.description:
In the past few weeks, armies of vampires and liches have been terrorizing this region. The vampires even had the audacity to build an estate right by your front door!

Their legions are standing ready, waiting for the order to attack. They must be stopped, and their undead leader must be sought out and destroyed!

map.cave of gerfrex.event.15.description: The time of the Dark Sun is rapidly approaching. There's little more than a week left to find and slay the evil Necromancer, Zarachodar. You must hurry or all will be lost!
map.cave of gerfrex.event.16.description: You are filled with dread, for the time of the Dark Sun is almost upon you. Already, the air has changed, and it feels stifling in your lungs. High up above you, a shadow of darkness begins to shroud the life-giving heavenly god. Soon the forces of darkness will roll over you with unstoppable ease, and Zarachodar, the Necromancer, will triumph. Your DOOM is imminent!
map.cave of gerfrex.event.17.description: You recall hearing about a very wise old mystic who lives the other side of an invisible maze. If anyone can figure out a way to deal with the vampires, surely it will be him.

map.cave of gerfrex.event.20.description:
Your mother and father are getting old, and your brothers are all away right now. Your favourite brother, Crag Hack (that crazy fool), went up north to wage war against the giants. You miss his jokes, and pray that he will return safely home one day soon.

So it's down to you, Lydorie, first daughter of the Clan of Battlement, to deal with this undead threat. And time is running short--in just three months the time of the Dark Sun will come--and the undead will be too strong to ever stop. You must find and defeat this evil Necromancer before that can occur.

map.cave of gerfrex.event.28.description:
You pause in your quest to reflect upon what might happen if you fail. The last time the Dark Sun came while a powerful Necromancer King lived, the world was thrown into chaos for many months. A hideous black plague spread through the towns and villages, killing thousands of men, women and children overnight in their beds as their feverish minds dreamed nightmarish dreams. And that was just the beginning! Soon afterwards, the Necromancer King animated their sore-ridden bodies into armies of Zombies that ran amok, killing all in their path and spreading still more foul disease. Their numbers swelled and it was only by the timely intervention of the High Guild of Wizards that this cataclysm was ever brought to an end.

But where is the High Guild when you need them now? No doubt they are secretly watching (as is their nature), but you cannot be sure they will help, and you certainly cannot rely on them. It is up to you, Lydorie, to stop this threat before it's too late!

map.cave of gerfrex.guards.15.4.0.messag: You stand before the hut of the wise old mystic. Will he really be able to help you with your vampire problem? Well, there's only one way to find out--enter and speak with him!
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.15.7.0.messag: Wow! This pile of gold is HUGE! This should really help in financing your war against the evil Necromancer!
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.15.9.0.messag:
A funny little Pooka appears and says, "Congratulations, Lydorie! You have made it through the invisible maze."

"{You are hereby granted the ability to transform}
{your goblins and hobgoblins into trolls!}"

"But...you must also have enough gold to pay for their expensive rehabilitation and training."

The Pooka then giggles, darts behind the fountain and vanishes.
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.16.12.0.messa: You feel a little queasy in your tummy as the landscape swirls around you.
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.17.25.0.messa: You pull the lever, and immediately hear a loud grinding sound coming from inside your castle. But now the lever's jammed and it's impossible to move again. How odd...
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.18.19.1.messa: You stow away this large cache of crystals!
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.18.20.1.messa: You happily stash this large pile of gems!
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.18.21.1.messa: Gold, gold, gold, everywhere there's GOLD!
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.19.16.1.messa: Reverently, you pick up the Helm of Heavenly Enlightenment.
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.19.17.1.messa: You quickly gather up an enormous pile of gold!
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.19.19.1.messa: You quickly gather up a huge pile of gold and command your most trusted men to carry it.
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.20.16.1.messa: You quickly gather up this huge pile of gold, awed by the vast fortune Gerfrex has accumulated!!
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.20.18.1.messa: Delightedly, you pick up the Celestial Necklace of Bliss.
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.20.19.1.messa: You gather up another huge pile of gold, chuckling happily at your good fortune!
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.20.21.1.messa: You quickly store away this large cache of gems!
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.20.5.1.messag: A wisp of smoke and the smell of burning parchment alerts you to the uncomfortable realization that your scrolls are on fire! You quickly snuff out the flames but it's too late--they're now blackened and useless!
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.21.16.1.messa: You carefully stow away more gold, filling a large sack with the shiny treasure!
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.21.18.1.messa: This pile of gold is the second largest you've ever seen!
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.21.20.1.messa: Your army happily bears the burden of yet another large sack of gold!
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.21.21.1.messa: Straining under the weight, you gleefully heave one more sack of gold over your shoulder!
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.22.18.0.messa: Stealing the shoes of a Saint--have you no shame!
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.22.18.1.messa: You happily gather up these many crystals!
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.22.19.1.messa: You quickly secure this huge pile of gold, filling your boots, gloves and pockets with glittering coins!
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.23.21.0.messa: You come upon an ancient burial place, quiet and serene. It amazes you that nobody has found and looted it yet. Perhaps it's because the ground here is holy.
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.25.10.0.messa:
You come upon a larger community of elves. They greet you suspiciously at first, but once you tell your tale and explain why your army is so ugly, they sympathize and are elated that you have slain the evil witch. They invite you in for a glorious meal that refreshes your body and raises your spirits.

"Brave hero," speaks the leader of the elven community, "how can we ever thank you enough! Here, take these riches--gems, crystals and gold from our treasury--and four dozen of our best archers with you, and perhaps this bowstring fashioned from a unicorn's mane will help you too."
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.25.31.0.messa:
The grand elves hail you as you draw near...

"An evil old witch has been performing black magic and vile sorceries on our kin just up the road from here. If you meet her, do not trust her--you must slay her at once! And here, take this bow and these arrows, perhaps they will be of help."
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.26.29.1.messa: You find yourself in a natural tunnel beneath the ground. A spring from the rocky wall feeds a small muddy stream that winds through the subterranean passages and disappears from sight in the darkness ahead.
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.26.5.1.messag: Ahead of you lies the burning bridge. The heat is incredible, but somehow you know it will not harm you. A lone, robed figure guards it, sitting astride a black horse with fiery-orange fur. Are you brave enough to go across?
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.27.14.0.messa: This must have been the old hag's cooking pot, but for some odd reason it's filled with mercury. You decide to take it with you.
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.28.32.1.messa: You hear something clink and splash as your boot hits it and knocks it into the stream. Investigating closer, you fish out an ornately designed ring that someone must have lost eons ago.
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.29.8.0.messag: As you leave behind the merriment of this vibrant elven community, you're comforted by the presence of the 48 archers that have agreed to accompany you on your adventures. You look forward to hearing their beautiful elvish songs around the campfires at night and learning much elvish lore. Yes, elves aren't bad folk, really, though quite different from the goblins, orcs and ogres of your home.
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.3.3.0.message: You stand before a subterranean gate and a chill runs down your spine. Who knows what terrors await to torment you, far beneath the surface of this land.
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.30.22.1.messa: Eww..several icky things have just climbed aboard your boat! Each one possesses a single, many-faceted eye that sparkles like crystal.
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.31.1.0.messag: The evil spirits rise up and attack you!
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.31.13.1.messa:
"So what else is down here, Vandula?" you ask of your old friend.

"There's some sort of fiery bridge up ahead, Lydorie. I don't know what it is, but it scares the hell out of me! You go ahead and I'll stay here and guard the portal in case anyone (or any {thing}) else comes through."
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.31.25.1.messa: A small underground lake! How intriguing. At least there's a boat so you can cross to the other side.
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.32.25.0.messa:
You come upon some ugly creatures, moaning and wailing with sadness.

"We were once {elves}!" they cry, shaking with sorrow, but unable to cry tears because of their lack of eyes. "A hideous evil witch did this to us! She changed us into monsters!"

You're shocked and angered. That witch must be truly evil to have done this foul deed! 

"Did she attack you unprovoked?" you ask, shaking with hatred and loathing.

The unsightly creatures mumble and hedge, but finally admit that they attacked the witch first, "but she {is} evil! We're not the first people to have been cursed by her vile sorceries. That's {why} she must be slain!"
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.32.27.0.messa: Dammit, there's no way past this gate. Well not until you can find a black tent, anyway.
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.5.29.1.messag: You've reached a dead end. There seems to be no way through this mountain. But surely there {must} be a way! Perhaps there's a hidden cave entrance somewhere?
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.6.27.0.messag: With the vampires gone, many of the liches guarding the eastern pass also decide to flee, but a horde of them still remains and must be dealt with.
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.7.34.1.messag: You have come upon the foreboding spires of the Castle of Evil, dark lair of Zarachodar! One way or another, your quest is almost at its end...
map.cave of gerfrex.guards.8.22.1.messag: Uh oh! Looks like one of Zarachodar's evil minions is standing guard. Prepare to fight!
map.cave of gerfrex.header.description:
The Necromancer Zarachodar has his undead legions poised to attack. You have just three months to find and defeat him before the time of the Dark Sun arrives and all is lost!

In this exciting ERM story map, you'll have the opportunity to make real decisions that affect the course of the game.
map.cave of gerfrex.header.name: Cave of Gerfrex v1.4
map.cave of gerfrex.header.rumor.0.text: Gerfrex isn't fond of greedy people.
map.cave of gerfrex.header.rumor.1.text: There really is a way through the maze, but you have to take it slowly--one step at a time.
map.cave of gerfrex.header.rumor.2.text: Do not give in to the temptations of darkness!
map.cave of gerfrex.header.rumor.3.text: The hidden entrance to an ancient burial ground is located near the volcano.
map.cave of gerfrex.header.rumor.4.text: The Mad Monk despises fools and liars.
map.cave of gerfrex.header.rumor.5.text: An old and powerful witch has been terrorizing the elves in this region.
map.cave of gerfrex.header.rumor.6.text: A swarm of evil spirits guards the black tent. If they don't like you, they'll kill you!
map.cave of gerfrex.heroes.102.biography: Crag Hack, first son of the Clan of Battlement is a fierce warrior and a loyal friend. He's especially valued for his skill at training goblins and hobgoblins to be as strong as ogres in battle. Crag is the somewhat reckless but lovable brother of Lydorie, and would lay down his life for her if need be. He's always cracking jokes and loves to drink and tell stories. He also has a keen eye for finding paths through difficult terrain and is always off exploring new lands.
map.cave of gerfrex.heroes.106.biography: Lydorie, first daughter of the Clan of Battlement is a talented mage and a good warrior. She is fiercely loyal to her family, especially her older brother, Crag Hack, whose companionship she often enjoys when he isn't away on one of his long and frequent trips to distant lands. Lydorie is skilled with the bow and quick at getting around, though unlike her brother Crag Hack, she has no talent for finding hidden paths nor travelling quickly through difficult terrain.
map.cave of gerfrex.heroes.106.name: Lydorie
map.cave of gerfrex.heroes.63.name: The Mad Monk
map.cave of gerfrex.heroes.76.name: Zarachodar
map.cave of gerfrex.monster.11.12.1.mess: These walking dead things attack you mindlessly.
map.cave of gerfrex.monster.13.5.0.messa: Three axe-wielding minotaurs guard this pass, and they're not budging for no one!
map.cave of gerfrex.monster.14.17.1.mess:
Dread Knights block the way, guarding a heavily locked gate.

Upon seeing you, they attack immediately!
map.cave of gerfrex.monster.15.28.0.mess: The zombies shuffle around and bits of skin fall off their animated bones.
map.cave of gerfrex.monster.16.30.0.mess:
A legion of liches is blocking the pass, and they sure look mean!

The lich in charge (wearing a pair of wicked looking boots) shouts, "Our Master shall rule. You can not stop the power of Zarachodar!" And then they laugh an evil, terrifying laugh, "Mwahahahaha!"
map.cave of gerfrex.monster.18.17.1.mess:
Gerfrex, having magically cloned herself into seven angry faerie dragons, attacks you immediately!                                                                                 

"DIE HUMAN SCUM!" shout the Gerfrexes in unison, preparing their Deadly Spells.

"Zarachodar is a stupid old bag of bones, and I shall not become one of his undead abominations, now or ever!"
map.cave of gerfrex.monster.29.27.0.mess:
You stop a young peasant girl and ask her about the witch. She seems frightened but is willing to talk for a moment.

"Yes, the witch...she does do evil things when people try to hurt her but I don't think she's all bad. People just don't understand her. I met her once and she was kind of creepy, but she didn't hurt me. And now I have to go. Please let me go--don't make me fight you!"
map.cave of gerfrex.monster.32.3.0.messa: With their leader defeated, the few remaining elementals are easy to deal with.
map.cave of gerfrex.monster.33.23.0.mess: "Will you let us come with you?" plead the former elves. "Please don't ignore us. We promise not to become too much of a burden, and if we do, then you can send us on our way..."
map.cave of gerfrex.monster.34.21.0.mess: "Go awaaaay or we'll burrrrn you!" spit the fiery gogs. "This is our mine and you can't have it!"
map.cave of gerfrex.monster.4.23.0.messa:
This crystal mine is guarded by some shambling dead things that drool and slobber even as they amble slowly towards you.

Do the world a favour and kill them quickly!
map.cave of gerfrex.monster.4.29.0.messa: "Get away from our gold!" screech the harpies in shrill voices that hurt your ears.
map.cave of gerfrex.monster.4.4.0.messag: These guardian mummies do not seem pleased to meet you!
map.cave of gerfrex.monster.7.27.0.messa: The legions of vicious bloodsuckers snarl and hiss at you, baring their sharp white fangs and blood-stained lips. Their leader wears a distinctive red and black cowl and bellows, "We shall destroy you and take over this land! Our master, Zarachodar will RULE!"
map.cave of gerfrex.monster.9.31.0.messa: These hell dogs snarl and snap, their eyes blazing red while they race towards you, intent on tearing the meat from your juicy bones!
map.cave of gerfrex.quest.15.17.1.comple: Do you place the Still Eye of the Dragon in the keyslot to unlock the gate?
map.cave of gerfrex.quest.15.17.1.firstV: This gate is locked and reinforced with powerful magic. Only a special key-ring will unlock it. Do you have that key?
map.cave of gerfrex.quest.15.17.1.nextVi: This gate is locked and reinforced with powerful magic. Only a special key-ring will unlock it. Do you have that key?
map.cave of gerfrex.quest.16.25.0.comple:
"Hey, is that the Crown of the Supreme Magi you're wearing?" asks the Guardian of {The} {Lever}, excitedly!

"Pass it over if you want to have a  pull."

Do you hand over your valuable crown?
map.cave of gerfrex.quest.16.25.0.firstV:
An oddly-dressed man, wearing saffron ceremonial robes and armed with a curved blade is guarding this tower.

"I guard {The} {Lever}. By ancient prophecy, only the one who wears the Crown of the Supreme Magi is allowed to pull it!"
map.cave of gerfrex.quest.16.25.0.nextVi:
The guard grips his curved sword tight and grimaces.

"Sorry, but only the wearer of the Crown of the Supreme Magi may pass and pull {The} {Lever}."
map.cave of gerfrex.quest.17.4.0.complet: "Finally!" announces the mystic. "Here, send in the troll and I'll give you this magic bird in return. Take it and release it {behind} the Tree of Knowledge. The bird will seek out the vampire hoards and peck them into oblivion, leaving a mere shadow behind!"
map.cave of gerfrex.quest.17.4.0.firstVi: "I hear you have vampire problems," speaks the mystic when you enter his tiny hut. "Perhaps I can figure out a little spell or something, but I need some help around the hut--someone strong who can also protect me from intruders."
map.cave of gerfrex.quest.17.4.0.nextVis: "What? No luck in finding someone to help me with my chores and act as my bodyguard? Please keep looking."
map.cave of gerfrex.quest.35.8.0.complet:
The gnomish wizard greets you excitedly when you enter.

"You have my book! Thank you. Please, hand it over and I shall give you this magical ring that is the key to releasing the dragon, Gerfrex. She will aid you, Lydorie, for she knows a thing or two, and her lair is filled with riches. When the Dark Sun arrives, Zarachodar will turn her into a magical Death Dragon and ride her into battle. If this should happen, he will be unstoppable!

Also, I must warn you of the Bridge of Fire. When you reach it, you must answer for your actions. Go now. Hurry!"
map.cave of gerfrex.quest.35.8.0.firstVi:
You enter the hut of a funny little wizard who looks like a gnome and is dressed all in grey. He speaks to you excitedly.

"Lydorie, (yes, I know who you are), I need your help and in return I shall help you too, with information and a ring that is key to your quest. First, I need you to bring back a magical tome that was stolen by the earth elementals. They dwell just up the road from here. I'm afraid you may have to kill them to get the book back. Go now. Hurry!"
map.cave of gerfrex.quest.35.8.0.nextVis: The odd little gnomish man insists that you bring back the stolen tome. "Time is of the essence. You must hurry!"
map.cave of gerfrex.quest.9.9.1.complete:
The ancient woman who lives here beckons you inside for tea.

"Welcome, my child. I sense you have found the pendant that will restore my sight. Please let me have it, and in return I shall teach you a spell to summon a powerful bolt of lightning that will jump from foe to foe (provided you have the Wisdom to learn such as this)."

Do you hand over the pendant and join the old wise woman for tea and spells?
map.cave of gerfrex.quest.9.9.1.firstVis:
An ancient wise woman lives here. She is blind and seeks a special magical pendant to restore her sight.

"If only I could see to read my magic notes, I might be able to teach you a powerful spell." sighs the old woman.
map.cave of gerfrex.quest.9.9.1.nextVisi: "Alas," says the old wise woman. "Without my sight I cannot help you."
map.cave of gerfrex.town.12.25.0.event.0: 2001That grinding noise you heard was the sound of huge boulders being rolled away to reveal a behemoth cave!
map.cave of gerfrex.town.12.25.0.event.1: 2002You hear a great thundering rumble and dust fills the air. As you watch, amazed, a dozen huge and hairy behemoths stampede past you and into the town of Battlement to take up residence in their new lair.
map.cave of gerfrex.town.12.25.0.name: Battlement
